segments.en: At the port the night named, there is an Azumabito hull. The hull that is there is for flying a distance feet on the ground cannot reach. Today's story does not turn the way of boarding that for into a procedure. It does not. What it sets down is that Kiyomi had left that hull on the island. The reason she had left it was a bargain, and now it is a road. Armin comes to receive the road as the name of the morning circle. The face that comes to receive it is a face that passed the night.

Kiyomi hears the meaningless he says as practical work. The practical work she hears makes the distance into the hull's job.

segments.en: Mikasa has come to the port without receiving kill. The feet that have come are feet that followed the morning name, that distance is needed. Annie is beside the following. The Annie who is there runs, for the first time outside the crystal, in the same direction as the island's soldiers. The direction she runs is the hull. Floch's name calls the hull a traitor's vehicle. The two do not receive the name he calls. Without receiving it, they remain on the shore. The two who remain look at the hull's shadow from the same side.

segments.en: At the port, Connie counts the number of people as a continuation of the village entrance. The content he counts is whether the people who did not fire are still beside him. Jean's form is thin today in the beside that is there. In place of the thin report, he looks at the hull's shadow. The shadow he looks at is a distance far from his mother's village. segments.ja: アルミンは、岸の音より船体が浮くことを優先します。優先する理由は、浮かなければ夜の話が港で終わる、です。終わる話は、海の約束も、皿の怒りも、届かないままです。ままを、彼は許せません。許せない声で、キヨミとオニャンコポンに準備を続けさせます。続けさせるあいだ、フロックの名が岸を埋めます。埋める名は、船体の影を裏切りの形にします。形を着た影の下で、準備はまだ続いています。
segments.en: Armin gives priority to the hull lifting over the sound of the shore. The reason he gives priority is that if it does not lift, the night's talk ends at the port. With the voice that cannot permit it, he has Kiyomi and Onyankopon continue the preparation. While he has them continue, Floch's name fills the shore. The name that fills makes the hull's shadow into the shape of betrayal. Under the shadow that wears the shape, the preparation is still continuing.

segments.en: Traitor is not one side's word today. It is not. Floch calls the people who send the hull out by that word. The circle at the port, in their hearts, calls the people who do not stop the march a different betrayal. The way of calling does not come out of the mouth. Without coming out, both names are on the same shore. On the shore that is there, only Kiyomi's hull wears neither name. The not wearing is the last practical work of today. The practical hull has not lifted yet.

segments.en: Today's words. Traitor is the name Floch distributed at the port. The Azumabito hull is the road the night left. Kiyomi does not hand that hull to either flag. Onyankopon does not leave the seat of flying. Armin asks for a distance where a conversation can arrive. Magath, Reiner, and Pieck guard that distance on the shore. Mikasa has come without receiving kill. Hange sets the seat that goes to see the count of those being trampled. The shore she sets is no longer a place of talk. In the place that is not that, only the night's name remains.
